assurance_type.description: Assures product functions as intended (standard warranty)
assurance_type.accounting: Expense and liability (not separate performance obligation)
assurance_type.revenue: NO separate revenue (included in product price)

service_type.description: Provides additional service beyond assurance (extended warranty)
service_type.revenue: Allocate portion of transaction price, recognize over coverage period

standard_warranty_accounting.at_sale: DR Warranty Expense, CR Warranty Liability (estimate based on history)
standard_warranty_accounting.when_incurred: DR Warranty Liability, CR Inventory/Cash (actual costs)
standard_warranty_accounting.estimate: Based on historical claims, percentage of sales, or per-unit estimates

extended_warranty_accounting.at_sale: DR Cash/AR, CR Unearned Warranty Revenue (deferred revenue)
extended_warranty_accounting.over_time: Recognize revenue ratably over coverage period: DR Unearned Warranty Revenue, CR Warranty Revenue
extended_warranty_accounting.costs_incurred: Expense as incurred (or match to revenue if material)

calculation_example_standard.facts: Sell products for $1M. Estimate warranty costs 2% of sales. Actual warranty costs incurred $15K.
calculation_example_standard.at_sale: DR Warranty Expense $20K (2% × $1M), CR Warranty Liability $20K

calculation_example_extended.facts: Sell product $1,000 plus 3-year extended warranty $300. Allocate transaction price. First year, incur $50 warranty costs.
calculation_example_extended.at_sale: DR Cash $1,300, CR Revenue $1,000, CR Unearned Warranty Revenue $300
calculation_example_extended.year_1_revenue: DR Unearned Warranty Revenue $100 ($300 / 3 years), CR Warranty Revenue $100

service: Provides additional services beyond defect coverage

manufacturer_vs_retailer.manufacturer: Records warranty liability for products sold (both assurance and service type if applicable)
manufacturer_vs_retailer.retailer_selling_own_warranty: Retailer is principal, recognizes extended warranty revenue over coverage period
manufacturer_vs_retailer.retailer_selling_third_party: May be agent (recognize commission) or principal (depends on control)

adjusting_estimates.if_insufficient: Increase warranty expense and liability (debit warranty expense, credit warranty liability)
adjusting_estimates.if_excessive: Reduce warranty expense (debit warranty liability, credit warranty expense or contra-expense)

disclosure_requirements: Changes in warranty liability (beginning balance, accruals, utilization, ending balance)

product_recall_vs_warranty.recall: Systematic withdrawal of products due to safety issues. May require separate accrual as loss contingency.

cpa_exam_tips: Assurance warranty: Expense and liability at sale (estimate). NOT separate revenue.
Service/Extended warranty: Separate performance obligation, defer revenue, recognize over coverage period.
Standard warranty: DR Warranty Expense, CR Warranty Liability (at sale). DR Warranty Liability, CR Cash/Inventory (when incurred).
Extended warranty: DR Cash, CR Unearned Revenue (at sale). DR Unearned Revenue, CR Revenue (over time).
Distinguish: Required/short/defect coverage = Assurance. Optional/long/additional service = Service type.

cpa_exam_strategies.identification: Is warranty standard (assurance) or extended/optional (service)? Look for: Required vs optional, Short vs long duration, Defect coverage vs additional services.
standard_warranty_steps: 1. Estimate warranty costs (% of sales or per-unit)
2. At sale: DR Warranty Expense, CR Warranty Liability
3. When incurred: DR Warranty Liability, CR Cash/Inventory
extended_warranty_steps: 2. At sale: Defer revenue (CR Unearned Revenue)
3. Recognize revenue over coverage period (straight-line typically)
common_mistakes: Recognizing assurance warranty as revenue (should be expense/liability)
Expensing extended warranty costs immediately (should defer revenue and recognize over time)
Not distinguishing between assurance and service types
Forgetting to adjust warranty liability when actual experience differs

key_points: Assurance warranty: Expense and liability (NOT separate revenue). Estimate at sale.
Service/Extended warranty: Separate performance obligation, defer and recognize revenue over time.
Standard: DR Warranty Expense, CR Warranty Liability (sale). DR Warranty Liability, CR Cash (incurred).
Extended: DR Cash, CR Unearned Revenue (sale). DR Unearned Revenue, CR Revenue (over time).
